ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional short label shown above the main heading. HTML is allowed.

SectionHeading.helper: Required. Main heading shown in the section. HTML is allowed.

SectionHeadingElement.helper: Choose the semantic HTML element used for the main section heading. Styling stays the same.

IntroText.helper: Required. Main introductory content. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Military computing requirements extend across fixed facilities, vehicles, deployable environments, communications infrastructure, intelligence workflows, and temporary field operations.

ImageCount.helper: Choose whether this section renders only the primary image or the current two-image editorial composition. Secondary image fields are used only when Two Images is selected.

PrimaryImage.helper: Primary image used in both one-image and two-image modes. Recommended: landscape image with a clear focal point.

PrimaryImageAlt.helper: Optional. Describe the primary image for accessibility. If empty, the section heading is used as fallback.
PrimaryImageAlt.placeholder: Integrated computing systems in a fixed mission environment

SecondaryImage.helper: Optional. Used only when Image Count is Two Images; preserves the current secondary image composition.

SecondaryImageAlt.helper: Optional. Used only when Image Count is Two Images. Describe the secondary image for accessibility. If empty, the secondary heading is used as fallback.
SecondaryImageAlt.placeholder: Deployable computing system prepared for transport

SecondaryImagePosition.helper: Used only when Image Count is Two Images and both images are present. Controls the secondary image focal point used by CSS object-position.

SecondaryHeading.helper: Optional. Used only when Image Count is Two Images. Secondary heading shown in the editorial panel. HTML is allowed.
SecondaryHeading.placeholder: From Fixed Operations to Forward Deployment

SecondaryHeadingElement.helper: Choose the semantic HTML element used for the secondary heading. Styling stays the same.

SecondaryText.helper: Optional. Used only when Image Count is Two Images. Supporting text shown in the editorial panel. HTML is allowed.
SecondaryText.placeholder: The right platform depends on where it will operate, how it will be transported or installed, what it must connect to, and the workload it needs to support. Portexa can help evaluate these requirements before narrowing the configuration path.
